name: traveler-v1
chrf_floor_note: Calibrated from the NEU-61 kickoff sweep: measured corpus chrF 84.5 on the published v2.0.0 pack; floor = max(15.0, min(0.45 * chrF, chrF - 20)). A direction-mislabeled pack collapses far below this value (see the es-en adversarial control).

entries.source: Am nevoie de 3 bilete pentru mâine dimineață.
entries.reference: I need 3 tickets for tomorrow morning.

entries.source: Suntem 5 persoane, inclusiv 2 copii.
entries.reference: There are 5 of us, including 2 children.

entries.source: Numărul meu de telefon este 0044 7788 123456.
entries.reference: My phone number is 0044 7788 123456.

entries.source: Zborul durează 9 ore și 25 de minute.
entries.reference: The flight takes 9 hours and 25 minutes.

entries.source: Suntem 4 persoane și avem 6 valize.
entries.reference: We are 4 people and we have 6 suitcases.

entries.source: Camera 214 este la etajul doi.
entries.reference: Room 214 is on the second floor.

entries.source: Am sosit pe 3 octombrie și plec pe 9 octombrie.
entries.reference: I arrived on October 3 and I leave on October 9.

entries.source: La ce oră se deschide muzeul duminica?
entries.reference: What time does the museum open on Sundays?

entries.source: Trenul meu pleacă la 18:45 de la peronul 7.
entries.reference: My train leaves at 18:45 from platform 7.

entries.source: Ultimul autobuz pleacă la 23:30 în această seară.
entries.reference: The last bus leaves at 23:30 tonight.

entries.source: Am o rezervare la ora 8 seara pentru 2 persoane.
entries.reference: I have a reservation at 8 pm for 2 people.

entries.source: Farmacia se deschide înainte de ora 9 dimineața?
entries.reference: Does the pharmacy open before 9 in the morning?

entries.source: Turul începe la 14:15 și durează 3 ore.
entries.reference: The tour starts at 14:15 and lasts 3 hours.

entries.source: Micul dejun se servește între 6:30 și 10:00.
entries.reference: Breakfast is served from 6:30 to 10:00.

entries.source: Cât costă o cameră dublă pentru 3 nopți?
entries.reference: How much is a double room for 3 nights?

entries.source: Asta costă 45 de euro, inclusiv taxe.
entries.reference: This costs 45 euros, including tax.

entries.source: Există reducere pentru 2 adulți și 1 copil?
entries.reference: Is there a discount for 2 adults and 1 child?

entries.source: Biletul costă 12,50 euro de persoană.
entries.reference: The ticket costs 12.50 euros per person.

entries.source: Pot plăti cei 78 de euro cu cardul?
entries.reference: Can I pay the 78 euros by card?

entries.source: Cât costă autobuzul spre aeroport pentru 2 persoane?
entries.reference: How much is the airport shuttle for 2 people?

entries.source: Meniul zilei costă 15 euro cu băutură inclusă.
entries.reference: The menu of the day is 15 euros with a drink included.

entries.source: Adresa este Calle Mayor 15, etajul trei.
entries.reference: The address is Calle Mayor 15, third floor.

entries.source: Hotelul meu este pe Gran Vía 28, lângă metrou.
entries.reference: My hotel is at 28 Gran Vía, near the metro.

entries.source: Ambasada este pe Paseo de la Castellana 259.
entries.reference: The embassy is at Paseo de la Castellana 259.

entries.source: Vă rog să notați adresa: numărul 42, apartamentul 5B.
entries.reference: Please write down the address: number 42, apartment 5B.

entries.source: Punctul de întâlnire este Plaza del Sol, poarta 3.
entries.reference: The meeting point is Plaza del Sol, gate 3.

entries.source: Este acesta drumul spre Carrer de Balmes 112?
entries.reference: Is this the way to Carrer de Balmes 112?

entries.source: Unde este cea mai apropiată stație de autobuz?
entries.reference: Where is the nearest bus stop?

entries.source: Virați la stânga la semafor, apoi mergeți drept 200 de metri.
entries.reference: Turn left at the traffic lights, then go straight for 200 meters.

entries.source: Se poate ajunge pe jos de la gară la hotel?
entries.reference: Is the station within walking distance of the hotel?

entries.source: Care linie merge la aeroport, linia 5 sau linia 8?
entries.reference: Which line goes to the airport, line 5 or line 8?

entries.source: Scuzați-mă, acesta este locul 14A?
entries.reference: Excuse me, is this seat 14A?

entries.source: Cum ajung în orașul vechi de aici?
entries.reference: How do I get to the old town from here?

entries.source: Muzeul este la aproximativ 15 minute pe jos de piață.
entries.reference: The museum is about 15 minutes on foot from the square.

entries.source: Vă rog, chemați o ambulanță, cineva este inconștient.
entries.reference: Please call an ambulance, someone is unconscious.

entries.source: Mi-am pierdut pașaportul și portofelul.
entries.reference: I have lost my passport and my wallet.

entries.source: Unde este cel mai apropiat spital sau clinică?
entries.reference: Where is the nearest hospital or clinic?

entries.source: Sunt alergic la arahide; acest fel de mâncare conține?
entries.reference: I am allergic to peanuts; does this dish contain any?

entries.source: Cineva mi-a furat geanta cu 200 de euro înăuntru.
entries.reference: Someone stole my bag with 200 euros inside.

entries.source: Chemați poliția, vă rog. A avut loc un accident.
entries.reference: Call the police, please. There has been an accident.
